text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'll just put these documents for Shakur
over on
this table.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Phew... I should air out this room a little.
Woosh!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ack?! No, th-the documents are flying
away?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wait, please! D-don't go away! Come
baaack!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? The heck are you doing? Does this
look like
a dance studio to you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm really s-sorry! All your documents
were blown
away when the wind came
in...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't expect to get them back prancing
around
like that. Move your body with
intention and
precision!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeek! I'm s-s-sorry my movements are so
sloppy!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Then fix them. Doto, do exactly as I say!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The wind is flowing in from the southeast
at a
speed of three meters a second.
Adding the
current location of the
papers in my equation
would bring...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Make a dash for it on my count!
Three,
two, one—go!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, h-here goeees!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Good, that's one down. On to the next!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I want you to run all the way there!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, o-okay!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! It's time for the finisher, Doto.
Four
seconds from now, you need to
dive in for a
catch! Ready?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah! Oof?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I see you caught the last one with your
face and
not your hands. Your minimal
effort somehow
achieved the maximum
result.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I feel like my movement has
improved!

The following day, I notice Meisho
Doto's running
form has sharpened!
